messages:
ci-bot: nightly-performance-job detected regression on small-batch 128 (tail latency +7% vs baseline). job: https://ci.redwood.dev/jobs/9876 artifacts: s3://ci-artifacts/nightly/2179001234

alex: saw the alert, can someone grab the perf artifacts and point to suspect commits?

matt: recent PR #4523 changed batch coalescer timer (lowered flush delay). might be related.

rachel: i'll pull the artifacts and run the microbench locally. what command do you want me to run? :mag:

alex: try ./tools/run_bench --profile small-batch --batch-size 128 --runs 50 --commit HEAD

ci-bot: artifacts upload completed: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/9876/bench-snapshots.tgz

sophia: quick scan of flamegraphs in the archive shows repeated stalls in `kv_cache::serialize` on a few samples.

sophia: snippet from flamegraph (collapsed):
```
kv_cache::serialize  42%  
scheduling::yield     12%
allocator::maybe_gc   6%
```

kevin: i'll run a scoped profiler on the exact commit. landing a fix depends on repro.

matt: if batch coalescer reduced flush delay we could be doing more frequent short-lived serializations. cc @sophia

rachel: repro run started on my laptop, linking log when done. if we confirm, we should bisect between 945a2c..f3d1b9

alex: agreed. if bisect pins to PR #4523 we can either revert or tweak delay and ship a canary tomorrow.

ops-bot: scheduled bench job `nightly-sample-triage-217900` at 07:00 UTC for additional traces.

kevin: ran perf with `--perf-collect` -> uploading trace: https://ci.redwood.dev/traces/2179001234/kevin-perf.json

sophia: thanks, i'll look at traces now. if serialize is culprit, we can move to async flush of serialized blobs or batch KV writes.

alex: plan: 1) rachel confirms local repro 2) kevin + sophia analyze trace 3) bisect if needed 4) decide revert vs tweak by 09:30 UTC. ping me in thread when step 1 is done.

rachel: local run finished — confirmed ~8% tail increase. attaching minimal repro steps: `git checkout f3d1b9 && ./tools/run_bench --profile small-batch --batch-size 128`

matt: thanks. i'll open a quick revert PR so we have an easy rollback path: #4530

alex: :thumbsup: let's keep channel updated; this thread will be the source of truth for the triage.
